name: Brisk Ten
description: Walk briskly for 10 minutes: fast enough that talking takes a little effort.

name: Park walk
description: Walk around the park. 20 minutes is about 2,000 steps.

name: Walk a mile
description: Log the distance you walked or ran here. Your phone's step counter can tell you.

name: Walk or bike here
description: You got here on foot, by bike or by scooter instead of driving.

name: Bench Five
description: 10 squats, 10 push-ups against a bench, 10 calf raises. Counts toward your strength days.

name: Balance Break
description: Stand on one foot for 30 seconds each side, then walk 10 steps heel to toe. Hold a bench if you like.

name: Stretch it out
description: Five minutes of gentle stretching.

name: Play catch or frisbee
description: Toss something back and forth with someone.

name: Get Fit St. Pete class
description: Join a free Healthy St. Pete class or Neighborhood Walk. Check the City's Healthy St. Pete page for times.

name: Green Five
description: Sit or stand outside for 5 minutes with your phone away. Five minutes outdoors is enough to lift mood.

name: Awe walk
description: A 15-minute walk looking for something vast, new or surprising: the sky, the water, an old tree. Try a photo with you small in the frame.

name: Sunrise here
description: Catch the sunrise from the park. Mornings are cooler too.

name: Sunset here
description: Stay for the sunset.

name: Find the biggest tree
description: Find the biggest tree in the park and spend a minute with it.

name: Shade Seeker
description: Rest five minutes under a tree canopy and drink some water. Florida sun is no joke.

name: Breathe
description: Five minutes of box breathing: in for 4, hold for 4, out for 4, hold for 4.

name: Meditate
description: Sit quietly and notice your breath, sounds and the breeze.

name: Three Good Things
description: Think of three things you're grateful for today. Keep them to yourself: we don't ask what they are.

name: Read outside
description: A book, a magazine, anything on paper.

name: Sound map
description: Sit still and count five different sounds.

name: Phone down
description: Twenty minutes here with your phone in your pocket.

name: Say hello
description: Learn the name of a regular or a neighbor. Small chats with familiar faces add up.

name: Bring someone new
description: Bring along someone who has never been to this park.

name: Picnic
description: Share a meal outside with someone.

name: Across generations
description: Spend time here with someone from a different generation.

name: Who's this park named for?
description: Read the marker or the City's page and find out.

name: Wildlife spotter
description: Count the kinds of birds and animals you spot: ibis, pelican, heron, anole, squirrel…

name: Name a plant
description: Find out what one tree or plant here is called.

name: Try something new
description: Do something here you've never done before.

name: Pick 5
description: Pick up five pieces of litter and bin them.

name: Park cleanup
description: Join an organized cleanup at this park.

name: Trail time
description: Walk, run or bike the trail.

name: Exercise Zone circuit
description: One set at every station. Healthy St. Pete runs free Exercise Zone workouts too.

name: Play pickleball
description: Bonus points for joining open play with someone new.

name: Hit some tennis balls
description: A set, a rally or a bucket of serves.

name: Shoot hoops
description: Free throws, HORSE or a pickup game.

name: Field play
description: Play catch, run the bases, or cheer on a local game.

name: Paddle
description: Kayak, canoe or paddleboard. Water time gives the biggest mood boost.

name: Go fishing
description: From the pier or the shore. Check Florida's license rules first.

name: Barefoot beach walk
description: Walk the water's edge.

name: Lap the lake
description: Walk all the way around the lake. Look for turtles and herons.

name: View pause
description: Stop at the view for five minutes. Water and big skies are the best awe triggers.

name: Swim
description: Laps, water aerobics or a splash. Easy on the joints.

name: Take a class
description: Any class or program at the recreation center.

name: Skate session
description: Skate, scooter or BMX. Helmet on.

name: History hunt
description: Find the marker, sundial, midden or garden, and learn its story.

name: Host a picnic
description: Gather three or more people under the shelter. Bring fruit and veg.

name: Play again
description: Grown-ups too: climb, swing and slide, ideally alongside a kid.

name: Shuffleboard
description: St. Pete is the home of shuffleboard. Play a game.

name: Paw-trait
description: A photo of you and your pet at this park.

name: Pet walk
description: Walk your pet. Check the pavement first: if the back of your hand can't stay on it for 7 seconds, it's too hot for paws.

name: Sniffari
description: 15 minutes where your dog sets the pace and sniffs as much as they like. Sniffing makes dogs happier.

name: Training five
description: Five minutes practicing sit, stay or come.

name: Meet a new dog
description: Say hi to another pet and their person, and learn the pet's name.

name: Scoop + 1
description: Pick up after your pet, plus one more piece of litter.

name: Water stop
description: Offer your pet water in the shade.

name: Off-leash play
description: Let them run in the dog park.

name: Pet picnic
description: A picnic with pet-safe treats for them too.

name: Nature Bingo
description: Find something red, something round, something rough, a feather and a seed.

name: Animal Moves
description: 10 bear crawls, 10 frog jumps, 10 crab walks.

name: Tag or a race
description: Who's it?

name: 60 a Day
description: An hour of active outdoor play. Kids need 60 minutes a day.

name: Kid Leads
description: For 10 minutes, the kid decides where everyone goes.

name: Bug Safari
description: Find as many bugs as you can. Look, don't touch.

name: Cloud shapes
description: Lie back and find animals in the clouds.

name: Quiet Spot
description: Two minutes of silent listening. How many sounds did you hear?

name: Tree Hug
description: How many arms does it take to hug the biggest tree?

name: Eat a color
description: A picnic snack with a fruit or vegetable in it.

name: Litter Patrol
description: Pick up litter with gloves on and a grown-up nearby.

name: Teach a grown-up a game
description: The kid explains the rules. The grown-up has to play.

name: Park Detective
description: Who is this park named for?

name: Top of the playground
description: Climb to the top, try every piece of equipment, cross the monkey bars.

name: Splash time
description: Splash pad, pool play or a swim lesson. Swim lessons save lives in Florida.

name: Run the bases
description: Or 10 catches in a row.

name: Make 5 baskets
description: Any distance counts.

name: Helmet ride
description: Bike, scooter or skate the trail with a helmet on.

name: Spot a turtle
description: Or a heron, or a fish.

name: Sandcastle
description: Build one. Count the shells you find (leave live ones).
